w2:textbox.label:
1. Click each createWindow() button.
2. Confirm that a window is created.
3. Click the restore button in the upper-right corner of the created window.
4. Confirm that it changes to the specified size.
(See the Script tab for the detailed script.)

/// Sample File

scwin.count = 0;

scwin.trigger1_onclick = function (e) {
   scwin.count++;
   var winObj = {
       title: "300x300",
       src: "window_src.xml",
       windowTitle: "300x300_Title",
       windowId: "300xd00_Id" + scwin.count,
       frameMode: "wframe",
       defaultWidth: "300",
       defaultHeight: "300"
   }
   windowContainer1.createWindow(winObj);
};

scwin.trigger2_onclick = function (e) {
   scwin.count++;
   var winObj = {
       title: "200x200",
       src: "window_src.xml",
       windowTitle: "200x200_Title",
       windowId: "200x200_Id" + scwin.count,
       frameMode: "wframe",
       defaultWidth: "200",
       defaultHeight: "200"
   }
   windowContainer1.createWindow(winObj);
};
